Data & Analytics Engineer · Power BI Analyst

items.title: Pipeline sprawl, rebuilt as metadata
items.problem: About 350 hand-maintained ADF pipelines and 165 per-client source setups, for 33 clients with 5 channels each.
items.solution: Metadata-driven pipelines: connections, mappings, parameters and run controls moved into reusable config files.
items.result: 33 production pipelines on 4 standard source patterns. A new client is now a config change, not new code.

items.title: A tenant migration without the manual grind
items.problem: 625 reports had to move to a new enterprise tenant, each one deployed and permissioned by hand.
items.solution: A GUI migration and governance app: transfer, workspace mapping, validation and access provisioning.
items.result: 625 reports and access for about 80 workspaces moved, with fewer deployment and access errors at cutover.

items.title: Data quality before the report, not after
items.problem: Bad source files showed up as broken reports and were fixed one file at a time.
items.solution: Schema validation, source-to-target mapping, duplicate detection and reconciliation ahead of Power BI.
items.result: Fewer report failures and faster fixes on datasets above 600K records.

items.title: Slow executive reports, made fast
items.problem: Finance, sales and operations reporting was scattered, and the executive reports were slow.
items.solution: Model redesign, aggregation tables, query folding and DAX tuning, on governed semantic models with RLS.
items.result: Reports up to 70% faster, with the KPIs in one drillable view for leadership.

items.title: From vague requests to numbers people trust
items.problem: Requests arrived vague, and report issues were patched where they showed up.
items.solution: Dimensional models, standard KPI definitions, source-to-report reconciliation and automated data prep.
items.result: Reporting stakeholders relied on, with the business logic written down.

items.title: SQL first, then Power BI
items.problem: Reports were built on manual source extracts.
items.solution: Reusable SQL queries and views, then Power BI reports, DAX and stable gateway refreshes.
items.result: The start of eight years in Power BI.
